verdict.rationale: mParticle documents extensive public APIs (event ingestion HTTP API, Real-time API, Warehouse Sync API, Audiences API, platform APIs) that let developers programmatically drive data in/out of the product, and client SDKs. missing for 10: no explicit AI-agent-oriented API docs (e.g., OpenAPI spec for agents, auth/rate-limit details) or independent hands-on verification of API usability beyond vendor docs.
